cards.title: School holidays: Working parents' logistical nightmare
cards.body: Working parents face constant scheduling challenges juggling school hours with work demands. One parent advocates for rethinking school holidays as genuine family time rather than stressful admin.

cards.title: Hosting at home: Shame and parental overwhelm
cards.body: Parents today feel embarrassed inviting friends over due to toy-filled homes and lack of time. The shift away from casual home entertaining has changed how families build community.

cards.title: Halloween magic: Creating moments with your kids
cards.body: One parent is embracing Halloween traditions to create meaningful family connections rather than cynicism. Celebrating autumn through pumpkins and seasonal activities can be a moment of magic for children.

cards.title: AI changing how children learn and struggle
cards.body: Children need opportunities to make mistakes and figure things out independently for real learning. AI is reducing these essential learning struggles that build critical thinking skills.

cards.title: Don't diagnose other people's neurodivergent kids
cards.body: It's never appropriate to label or diagnose someone else's child, even with good intentions. Parents should focus on offering supportive actions rather than making medical assessments.

cards.title: ADHD strategies work better when you commit
cards.body: Acting as if ADHD solutions will work can be a powerful mindset shift for trying new strategies. A fair chance at implementation often reveals their true effectiveness.

cards.title: Why abuse survivors can't simply 'just leave'
cards.body: Leaving an abusive relationship is often the most dangerous time for survivors, not a simple escape. Meaningful support and understanding the complexities involved are critical for safety.
